================================================================================
FINDING 1 — Z9 CANNOT BE MET BY CONFIGURATION: the harness has NO general blocking
turn-finalisation hook. This needs a CORE change (or it stays unmet).
================================================================================
The harness offers exactly TWO surfaces that touch the end of a turn. Both were read live:

  (a) `on_session_end` — fired from `agent/turn_finalizer.py::finalize_turn()`, the OUTERMOST
      finalisation boundary; on the same path for a normal end, a tool error, a model error, an
      unhandled exception and an interrupt/cancellation.
      POWER = OBSERVE ONLY. Its return value is DISCARDED (collected into a list nobody reads).
      The shipped docs confirm: catalog row `on_session_end` = "Observer ... Return ignored."
      ⇒ a callback here can DETECT a refused end and CANNOT prevent one.

  (b) `pre_verify` — the ONLY surface whose return value can keep a turn going, consulted by
      `agent/turn_stop_gates.py::_pre_verify_nudge()` via `get_pre_verify_continue_message()`,
      honouring `{"action":"continue","message":...}` (re-enters the turn loop with a synthetic
      user turn).
      POWER = BLOCK, with two hard limits, both read from the live source:
        - LIVE SOURCE, `agent/turn_stop_gates.py`:
              if _edited and has_hook("pre_verify") and attempt < max_verify_nudges():
          It fires ONLY when the turn mutated files (`agent._turn_file_mutation_paths`), and it is
          BOUNDED by `agent.max_verify_nudges` (default 3).
        - docs: "Fires once per turn when the agent edited code ... Bounded: consecutive continue
          directives in one turn are capped by agent.max_verify_nudges (default 3), so a hook that
          always says continue can never trap the loop."

CONSEQUENCE: for a NON-file-mutating turn — which is exactly the HOLD/WAIT turn Z9 must cover —
no configured surface can refuse the end. Z9's requirement ("stand-down HOLD/WAIT state rejects
termination mechanically") is therefore UNREACHABLE without a harness-core change: the refusal
gate must be consulted on the OUTERMOST finalisation path (`turn_finalizer`/`conversation_loop`)
with a re-entry, not only on the mutation-gated `pre_verify` nudge.

PRIOR ART ALREADY IN THIS INSTALL (use it, do not re-invent): plugin `b4-turn-gate` registers
BOTH arms and documents these exact limits itself, with a marker-file scope (`<gate root>/staged/
b4_turn_gate.scope`), mission-unconditional enforcement, fail-closed on any error, and a
CREATE_NO_WINDOW child so it can never take focus. It is the correct TEMPLATE for the Z9 guard;
what it cannot do is fire on a turn that mutated no files — that is the core gap, not a plugin bug.

I am NOT patching the harness unilaterally: a core change to turn finalisation affects every session
in every profile. Owner/MD call.
